newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - BTP vols bubble as future hits new high.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - BTP vols bubble as future hits new high.

text.p: Implied volatility of Italian BTP options shot higher on Wednesday, in line with a sudden leap in the underlying futures market, traders said.

The December BTP future rocketed to a contract high at 126.43 earlier in the session as the market was boosted by optimism about Italy's chance of joining a single European currency group and the U.S. presidential elections.

"There was a sudden move in the futures this morning and volatility moved up quite sharply," said an options broker on the LIFFE floor. "There was a spate of panic vol buying early on in the session." Traders quoted vols on BTP options at around 9.2 percent offered by 1445 GMT, but said it they had seen it trade quite a bit higher than that in early trade.
LIFFE data showed that December calls at the 126.00 strike ended that day at 8.37 percent on Tuesday.
Call options and call spread trades seemed to be the order of the day, players said, with the biggest trade seen in the 128.00 to 130.00 strike call spread.
"We've seen buyers of those," said another LIFFE trader. "People are obviously expecting the future to go higher."
December BTPs recoiled from their new contract high on Wednesday and were trading 16 basis points higher on the day at 125.76 by 1509 GMT.
While options traders said they thought the contract could push up in the near term, they said its move was likely to be more measured than in recent sessions.

"We're going into a period of consolidation now," said the broker. "With the U.S. election out of the way and nothing expected from the Bundesbank council meeting tomorrow, vols should soften a bit in the coming days."
